title: Cofinite sparse-family closure in the third Krein scale
summary: The s=3 author proof adds the second centre trace: cofinite density requires retention of indices 0,1,4, with sufficiency supplied by local cutoff and corrected polynomial approximation.
conditions: Fixed real c>0, complex Hc^3=D(Kc^(3/2)) with its power norm.
N is a cofinite subset of D; all spans are finite complex spans.
Use Hc3=H3_Sob intersect ker B with equivalent norms, proved in proof03 C1.
scope: Only cofinite subsets of this specified family at s=3. No claim at s=5/2, for infinite deletions, arbitrary constrained families or stable bases.
content: closure_Hc3 span{pn:n in N}={f in Hc3: 0 notin N implies f(0)=0; 1 notin N implies f'(0)=0; 4 notin N implies f''(0)=0}. Codimension is |{0,1,4} minus N|. Proof: high complete tails with m0>=3 equal compatible polynomials divisible by x^(2m0−2); their closure is ker(f(0),f'(0),f''(0)) by local third-derivative cutoff estimates and a fixed endpoint right inverse. Independent trace vectors are p0,p1,p4, with p4''(0)=−4. This includes sufficiency, not merely necessary traces. Removing p4 gives a codimension-one obstruction; removing p5 alone does not. No independent approval is asserted.
